# Extended regular expressions for content that must not be committed.
# scripts/check-sensitive.sh reads one pattern per line; blank lines and lines
# starting with # are ignored. Keep every pattern generic: patterns that would
# reveal what the private terms protect belong with those terms, as "re:"
# lines, outside the repository.
/Users/[A-Za-z]
/home/[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*/
/private/(tmp|var)/
/var/folders/
[A-Za-z]:\\Users\\
Claude (Opus|Sonnet|Haiku|Code)
(^|[^A-Za-z])(Opus|Sonnet|Haiku) [0-9]
(^|[^A-Za-z])(GPT-[0-9]|Codex|Gemini [0-9])
Claude [A-Z][A-Za-z]* [0-9]
# Model trailers: the scanner drops the one allowed trailer from commit
# messages before matching, so any other co-author line naming a model fails.
^[Cc]o-[Aa]uthored-[Bb]y:.*([Cc]laude|GPT|[Gg]emini|[Cc]odex|noreply@anthropic)
# Agent-session links and session trailers.
^[A-Za-z]+-[Ss]ession:
claude\.ai/(code|chat)/
chatgpt\.com/
